description: The most recent conversations in the sprkly inbox, newest first. One row per person per connected account, with their handle, how many of their messages are unread, and the last thing said. Pass unread_only to see only conversations waiting for an answer. Use profile_id and person_id from a row with sprkly_get_inbox_thread to read it. Needs inbox access, which the user allows on its own: a key made with inbox access ticked, or a connection that allowed it.
name: sprkly_list_inbox_threads
title: List inbox conversations
